# third_party / heka_reader.py

`heka_reader.py` 是 HEKA PatchMaster `.dat` 文件的解析模块，作者 Luke Campagnola，
来源仓库：https://github.com/campagnola/heka_reader （结构定义改编自 StimFit
hekalib.cpp）。原仓库未附带许可证文件，此处原样收录仅为离线安装便利
（`install.bat` 将其复制进虚拟环境）；使用/分发时请自行评估其许可条款。

英文：This module parses HEKA PatchMaster `.dat` files. Copyright by Luke
Campagnola (https://github.com/campagnola/heka_reader). The original repository
carries no license file; it is vendored here as-is for offline installation.
Review its licensing terms before redistribution.
